prior_importants.description: A branch can add `docſ/adr/NNNN-x.md` (long s, U+017F), which git's ASCII-only `icase` pathspec does not match. The ADR stage never sees it, even though APFS folds `ſ` onto `s` and puts the file in `docs/adr/`.

findings.description: `addedAdrPaths` does not pin `--ignore-submodules=none`. A session can write `diff.ignoreSubmodules=all` to the shared `.git/config`, then commit a gitlink at `docs/adr/0002-x.md` (a number the target already holds). The diff drops the gitlink, the stage passes, and a duplicate decision number lands that every later gate's `decisionPaths` counts.
findings.body:
**A session-written `diff.ignoreSubmodules` hides a gitlink under `docs/adr/` from the ADR stage.**

`addedAdrPaths` pins colour, external diffs, `--no-relative` and renames against session-written config. It does not pin submodule handling:

```ts
'diff',
'--no-ext-diff',
'--no-color',
'--no-relative',
'--no-renames',
'--diff-filter=A',
```

<https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/d2d76d8870b5506330063ae5117591b345d80166/src/core/adr-number.service.ts#L82-L102>

The repo already treats this route as reachable:
- `rawDiffEntries` pins `--ignore-submodules=none` because `diff.ignoreSubmodules` or a `submodule.<name>.ignore` "would drop a gitlink change" (`src/core/merge-gate.service.ts` L237-255).
- `merge-gate-untested.test.ts` L329-340 reproduces the attack by running `git config diff.ignoreSubmodules all` from a session worktree.

`GIT_SAFE_CONFIG` (`git-diff.client.ts` L395-432) has no `diff.ignoreSubmodules` entry. `scrubbedGitEnv` only strips the `GIT_CONFIG_*` environment variables, so the shared `.git/config` still applies.

**Trigger.**
1. The session runs `git config diff.ignoreSubmodules all`.
2. It runs `git update-index --add --cacheinfo 160000,<sha>,docs/adr/0002-x.md`, where 0002 is already on the target, and commits.

**Wrong result.** `addedAdrPaths` returns nothing, so neither the "already on the target" refusal nor the misnamed refusal fires, and `adrNumberStage` passes.
- The scope audit's `gitDiffPaths` is blind the same way.
- The one `160000` check in the gate (L2456) only turns off the untested-skip, so it refuses nothing.

Once merged, `decisionPaths` (`ls-tree --full-tree`, L279-283) lists the gitlink, and `ADR_DECISION` matches it by name. The target then holds two 0002 entries. A gitlink at `docs/adr/notes` would also land a misnamed entry that the stage exists to refuse. Peer reads share this function, so a peer's gitlink is hidden from them too.

**Fix.** A command-line `--ignore-submodules=none` overrides both the config and any per-submodule `ignore`. For consistency you can also add it to `decisionRenames` (L123-134), though there it only affects whether a rename pairs.

findings.description: The stage does not catch a branch that deletes `docs/adr/*`, commits `docs/adr` as a symlink to another folder, and adds a folder there with a duplicate number. The wide `doc*/adr/*` listing matches nothing it adds, so the stage passes. Every later `ls-tree … docs/adr/` then finds no decisions, so every number reads as free. The diff is very visible (every decision deleted). One fix is to refuse a tree whose `docs/adr` is not a tree entry.

The refusal's misnamed-file section has no count cap. A session adding many junk files under `docs/adr/` gets one refusal line per file, and the refusal is stored and printed again on every re-gate. Only the session's own gate is affected. Other path lists cap with `+N more` (`profile-compiler.service.ts:340`), and the same cap would keep this readable.

process_issues.description:
Round 6 budget: only correctness, security and guards ran.
- conventions, docs, context, simplicity and maintainability were skipped under the round budget.
- workflow-safety was skipped because nothing under .github/workflows changed.
- spec was skipped because there is no closing issue or --spec.

Correctness and security each ran two instances, since the diff is past the size gate (~1400 lines).
- Correctness was split into adr-number.service.ts internals and gate/CLI/dashboard integration plus peer selection. Both returned no findings.
- Security was split into git argv/evasion and output/resource bounds.

The prior important (the long-s pathspec) is resolved by the wide `doc*/adr/*` pathspec and the ADR_LOOKALIKE filter in da5f547. Both correctness and security confirmed the fix closes the gap.

The consolidator merged nothing. The opus validator confirmed the ignore-submodules important and its suggestion.

The head was unchanged at d2d76d8 when re-checked.
